data: What is the approximate maximum value of the shaded area for the blue line in the lower plot?

The question asks for the approximate maximum value of the shaded area for the blue line in the lower plot. From the caption, we know that the dark line represents the posterior mean, and the shaded region represents the 95% posterior credible interval. The lower plot shows two lines: one in red and one in blue. The blue line corresponds to the "NATO" category.

Looking at the lower plot, the blue line (NATO) has a shaded area representing the 95% posterior credible interval. The maximum value of this shaded area appears to be around 10 on the y-axis. Therefore, the approximate maximum value of the shaded area for the blue line is 10.
